exposure: low-dose esketamine combined with sufentanil intravenous patient-controlled analgesia (PCA)
outcome: Sufentanil consumption at 6 and 24 hours postoperatively
Pain scores at 6, 24, and 48 hours postoperatively
cohort: 140 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
finding: Adding low-dose esketamine to sufentanil PCA significantly reduced sufentanil consumption while providing equally effective post-cesarean analgesia in patients with gestational diabetes.
